phase_q_exit_criteria: Operator review of this read-only matrix acknowledges which prior semantic decisions remain accepted and which remain blocked; this review itself does not accept renderer policies.
Independent policy decisions are recorded for timebase/sampling, spatial mapping, visibility/region ownership, asset sizing/anchor/crop, and pixel rounding before any implementation design gate.
CHALLENGE_008 and CHALLENGE_009 remain excluded from any binding/coordinate consumer until 11-second vs 12-second conflict is explicitly resolved.
Any later binding approval has a separate decision record and dedicated negative/determinism tests.
No runtime, payload, media, renderer or production callsite is part of Phase Q.
